title: manni graph strict overlay v1.0.0
description: The strict overlay for manni:graph:1.0.0. Stack it beside the open vocabulary, which owns the closed `graph` block and its iiRDS enums. It narrows section keys to heading slugs and lineage references to single tokens.

graph.description: Strict narrows `sections` keys, `revision-of` and `derived-from`. Every other member of the block passes as the open vocabulary reads it.

propertyNames.description: A heading slug of lowercase letters, caseless letters and their marks, digits, `_` and `-`. It admits slugs from scripts without case, such as Han, Arabic and Devanagari. The pattern uses Unicode property escapes, so a validator must compile it with the ECMA-262 `u` flag, as Ajv does for a 2020-12 schema.

refList.description: A path or URL on one line with no surrounding space, alone or in each item of the list. A path may contain spaces.
